result: VoiceChat-TTS is retained as a high-value interruptible continuous-TTS architecture donor. Its primary paper supports direct LLM token-stream drive, interruption control tokens, silence-on-no-input and mid-utterance interruption without KV-cache reset. Current search did not establish German support, official public code/weights or a reproducible local release boundary, so no target-runtime dispatch is justified.
next_exact_gate: Keep the mechanisms as a provider-neutral Voice ABI donor; only reopen VoiceChat-TTS runtime evaluation when an official public artifact pins revision/license/dependencies and establishes German support.
